title: [Audit] 📊 Platform Volume & API Keys
description: The unfiltered firehose, quarantined so the forensic dashboards stay readable.

config.description: Total audited events, unfiltered. Beneath it, the distinct HTTP requests behind them — one request often emits several audit records.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS `All events` = COUNT(*), requests = COUNT_DISTINCT(attributes.http.request.id) | EVAL detail = CONCAT(CASE(requests < 1000, TO_STRING(requests), CONCAT(TO_STRING(ROUND(requests / 1000.0, 1)), "k")), " HTTP requests") | KEEP `All events`, detail

config.description: Events that survive the noise gate: what every other dashboard reads.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/msearch*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/scroll*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/esql/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/field_caps*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/async_search/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/resolve/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:admin/shards/search_shards")) AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted") OR attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time","space_get","space_find") OR (attributes.event.action == "http_request" AND attributes.url.original IS NOT NULL AND attributes.url.original RLIKE "https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/(internal/|api/content_management/rpc/(get|search|mget|bulkGet)).*") OR (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_get","saved_object_resolve","saved_object_find") AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*"))) | STATS `Signal` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Successful authentication events. Elasticsearch logs one per authenticated request, so credentials making many calls generate most of them.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.event.action == "authentication_success" | STATS `Auth success` = COUNT(*)

config.description: The machinery behind a query, not a decision anyone made: Elasticsearch search phases, ES|QL sub-requests, field_caps, async search and point-in-time; Kibana /internal/ page requests; reads of this suite’s own saved objects; and transport connection_granted.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action, attributes.event.action, kib_internal = (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time","space_get","space_find") OR (attributes.event.action == "http_request" AND attributes.url.original IS NOT NULL AND attributes.url.original RLIKE "https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/(internal/|api/content_management/rpc/(get|search|mget|bulkGet)).*") OR (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_get","saved_object_resolve","saved_object_find") AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*")) | EVAL band = CASE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance"), "infra-noise", attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/msearch*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/scroll*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/esql/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/field_caps*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/async_search/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/resolve/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:admin/shards/search_shards", "query-noise", kib_internal, "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "connection_granted", "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "authentication_success", "authn-volume", "signal") | WHERE band == "query-noise" | STATS q = SUM(n) | EVAL `Query internals` = COALESCE(q, 0) | KEEP `Query internals`

FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main","elastic.maintenance") | STATS `Infra health` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Percentage of the firehose that survives the noise gate. The lower this is, the more the other dashboards are earning their keep.

KEEP `Signal share`

config.content:
Every other dashboard applies a **noise gate**; this one does not, so the whole firehose stays measurable. Every event lands in exactly one band:
**Signal** — what the other dashboards read · **Auth success** — Elasticsearch's `authentication_success`, one per authenticated request
**Query internals** — search, ES|QL, Kibana `/internal/`, suite self-views, `connection_granted` · **Infra health** — `cluster:monitor/main`, `elastic.maintenance`

An API key's events carry its **creator's** email, so a busy key can read as a person: **Via API key** in *Highest-volume identities* shows how much of a name is a key.

Signal vs noise over time
config.description: Audit events per time bucket, stacked by band, so the top edge is the whole firehose and Signal sits on the baseline. Hover a segment for its band and the bucket total.

config.title: API key throughput
config.description: Events per named API key, busiest first. Click a key to pin it across the suite.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY attributes.api_key.name | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 12

config.title: Band share over time
config.description: Each bucket’s events as 100%, split by band. A rising Signal share means activity, not housekeeping, is driving the volume.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action, attributes.event.action, kib_internal = (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time","space_get","space_find") OR (attributes.event.action == "http_request" AND attributes.url.original IS NOT NULL AND attributes.url.original RLIKE "https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/(internal/|api/content_management/rpc/(get|search|mget|bulkGet)).*") OR (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_get","saved_object_resolve","saved_object_find") AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*")) | EVAL band = CASE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance"), "infra-noise", attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/msearch*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/scroll*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/esql/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/field_caps*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/async_search/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/resolve/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:admin/shards/search_shards", "query-noise", kib_internal, "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "connection_granted", "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "authentication_success", "authn-volume", "signal") | STATS events = SUM(n) BY `BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)`, band | EVAL ord = CASE(band == "signal", 0, band == "authn-volume", 1, band == "query-noise", 2, 3) | SORT ord | DROP ord | EVAL band = CASE(band == "signal", "Signal", band == "authn-volume", "Auth success", band == "query-noise", "Query internals", "Infra health")

config.title: Audit volume by source service
config.description: Elasticsearch versus Kibana audit volume over time. Elasticsearch audits every transport action, so it usually dwarfs Kibana.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), source = resource.attributes.service.name | EVAL source = CASE(source == "serverless-elasticsearch", "Elasticsearch", source == "serverless-kibana", "Kibana", source) | SORT source

config.title: Noisiest transport actions
config.description: Highest-volume Elasticsearch transport actions, unfiltered, with the number of identities behind each. ES|QL’s own fan-out (esql/compute, search_shards, field_caps[n]) is in Query internals, and much of it is dashboards querying this stream.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*), actors = COUNT_DISTINCT(COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name)) BY attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 10

config.title: Highest-volume identities
config.description: Unfiltered volume leaderboard — this is where the machine traffic shows up. An opaque id is a principal with no email or key name, usually an organisation-level Elastic Cloud API key, which the stream records only by id (often the credential running this suite). Via API key: how many of the row’s events came through a named API key.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | STATS events = COUNT(*), via_key = COUNT(attributes.api_key.name), actions = COUNT_DISTINCT(attributes.event.action) BY actor, actor_kind | EVAL actor_kind = CASE(actor IN ("<anonymous>","<unauthenticated-cloud-access-token>","<unauthenticated-saml-user>","<unauthenticated-cloud-api-key>"), "unauthenticated", actor IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana"), "platform", actor_kind) | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 10
